If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and price is rising, lower forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract bullish bias.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and price is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days) to offset bearish sentiment.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 within 2 days, adjust forecast downward by 1–2% for the next 5 days to reflect market exhaustion.  
If sentiment is 0.00 for 3+ consecutive days, reduce forecast by 1–2% for all horizons to signal lack of momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and price is flat, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for late horizon to anticipate minor upward drift.
